english.note: Use 定力 as the all-purpose noun when poise means staying calm and unflustered under pressure.
Use this for composure or self-control, especially the ability to remain steady under provocation.

examples.english: Even under so much pressure, they can keep their poise; that is truly impressive.
You keep your temper even when people yell at you; that's impressive.
examples.traditional: 你畀人鬧都咁有定力，真係難得。
